evidence_note: Opened 2026-10-07: the White Tail Solar application PDF on Augusta Charter Township's site says the project is 'on fourteen privately-owned parcels within Augusta Township, Washtenaw County, Michigan'. The township's resolutions page (augustatownship.org/resolutions/, opened) lists '22-08 Resolution for Moratorium Large Scale Solar Projects'; the signed resolution (augustatownship.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/22-08-Resolution-for-Moratorium-Large-Scale-Solar-Projects-Final-Signed.pdf, opened, scanned, read by OCR) was adopted by the Augusta Township Board of Trustees, County of Washtenaw, on Tuesday, March 22, 2022, and imposes a moratorium on Large Solar Energy System uses for six months, extendable by up to six months. Agrees with the county column of the Sabin extraction (Washtenaw County).
